newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate bonds end flat, unshaken by supply.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate bonds end flat, unshaken by supply.

text.p: U.S. corporate high-grade bonds were unshaken by a bolt of fresh supply on Wednesday and closed with spreads mostly unchanged, dealers said.

Leading the pack, NationsBank issued $1.45 billion in three parts via lead manager NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc. All tranches were said to find "decent" demand and were quoted issue bid late in the session.
